review_description: The sales process was excellent; responsive, informative, considered and proved to be highly competitive (sought 7 quotes).Installation was timely and at the end of the day, went well. A couple of minor glitches were promptly and effectively resolved. The team was informative, friendly and punctual.I was well informed about use and operation,The Sigen battery is working very well.

Based on the advice and ratings provided on the Solar Quotes web site I selected the panels and inverter I wanted and the company was happy to quote on these and suggest improvements.The installation went very quickly and smoothly with the system installed in half a day.I was very impressed that after the installation was completed the company sent out their Quality Inspector who picked a couple of minor issues which were rectified by the installers a couple of days later
My consultant is Mark Bainbridge.  He answered my questions patiently and generated different Daily Energy Output report for me to consider the plan and how many panels to install.

Spot On Solar were not one of our three Solarquote companies but they were one of a family members Solarquote recommendations. We also checked them out with the Clean Energy Council. We wanted either micro-inverters or optimisers due to some shading issues and that was a very confusing and time consuming part of our research, finally going with optimisers through Lotus Energy (part of the Spot On Solar group). Sean from Spot On came out for an on-site quote, was a very good communicator and I could ring him at any time. Our system is 6.6 Kw with 20 x Seraphim Blade optimised panels and a Solar Edge inverter. The total price was $6588. The install date was about 6 weeks after the deposit went in and there were no issues.
great service from the first introduction quote and then the sales and installation, always contactable

We got all our info from solar quotes (awesome site)then went through a lot of quotes through different companieschose spot on solar because.sales and quoting were professional and pressure free.suggested a few changes that turned out to be a very good choices.communication was excellent .with a clear no B/S contract.install team were professional ,polite and punctual.the house is 2 levels limited access but the blokes just got stuck in and got the job done .system is new so we will have to wait and see how it goes .

Sales were good but once we paid the deposit we had a few communication issues.Installation was on time and efficiently done. The electrical side is well done but the framing is a little rough (ends of the mounting frames are roughly cut).Communication issues continued once installation was complete but we got through it.Grid connection is all sorted, we have all our documentation and we are getting paid for our excess generation.
Difficult to rate quality as it has only been in operation for 10 days.

After a very competitive price and great system recommendations we decided to go with Spot on Solar. Its one of those decisions that we will never regret. The install went well and had no impact on us and all was left tidy. The system works a treat and performs even better than our expectations. Spot on got all the grid work done in time and it was up and running without delay. Subsequent to installation (due to it being an older house ) we needed some advice from them. They were out here in virtually no time and helped us way beyond expectations. Big thanks to Stuart and the team. I cannot recommend them highly enough.

The salesman was very helpful, he knew the solar game very well, he was easy to talk to and answered all my questions regarding to solar. There was some hold up with supplying the equipment, but once they arrived to do install, they proceeded with tradesman quality. They were both polite and tidy, leaving no rubbish behind. They keep me informed of progress throughout the day and showed me photos of roof and panels so I could see just how neat the install was. I already had a smaller solar system connected to the grid so the new system was easily connected in parallel with it. All in all I would have no hesitation in recommending 'Spot on Solar'

Spot on Solar was very adaptable with the arrangement of the PV panels on the available roof space, and they were happy to listen and accommodate changes, right up to the last minute on both the price and capacity of the final system. The team confirmed an installation date, and they confirmed the time the night before the installation, which was on the agreed date. Overall a positive pain free experience.
install hasn't yet taken place. happy to provide a review and photos after install
Sales process low key and informative- no pressure.Installation not done yetOne stop shop for all the system.

Mark from Spot on Solar listened to what I wanted and was able to match exactly that. The installation works perfectly in with the other two previously installed systems. Process was pain free and the service second to none.Thanks again to mark and the spot on team
sales and quoting very good.Installation very good.very polite punctual.Grid installation organized for 14/1
Very happy with every aspect of the installation and Customer service
I'm very happy with the outcome. I went for quality over price, and so far it seems to be the right choice. All in all I'm happy with Spot On Solar.

Great work from start to finish, I have received my latest bill and I am in credit $126 for the quarter, excited to see what happens next.Fronius system monitoring with smart meter is great to see what I can use while generating power
Good system and not too expensive, timely installation . Good value in total.
sales and quote very promptwork done exceptional and good, very satisfied with job

Having received three quotes, one supplier just quoted a price. Another wanted to push their solution. Spoton Solar listened to what my needs were and, we worked the solution out together. The Salesperson came out to our home, we discussed needs etc and, we chose to go with LG Neon R panels as they are the latest technology from LG. Whilst we are still at the lowest arc of the sun and our panels face west, the results so far are very pleasing. It is great to see what power we are producing and, it has made us think twice about what appliances we use when and for how long, in order to maximize using the power we are generating and not importing from the grid.Everyone at Spoton Solar has been great to deal with. The installation guys left our premises spotless, other than the panels on the roof you'd hardly known they had been here.Thanks Finn for the insights and research material you provided, it certainly made our job easier.
Still have not turned the system on because I need a new smart meter!!Also unable to lock a date in for the new meter!

As for not knowing much about solar I hope to believe I got the best dealThe sale man Sean from spot on solar anwered all the questions I had.And the install team was good from LV electricalThanks Shane Keir.

Little bit slow on sending out feed in tariff information as promised, however they were great to deal with and very efficient in the installation process.  Will wait and see what the first electricity bill is to see whether this system is fantastic or not. Too early to really comment on that.  Would recommend this company.
